feature: Edit Original never folds a stray drop into the component
summary: With a component's original open, a copy of that same component, or anything dropped on the bare page beside the drawing, is now refused under the pointer instead of quietly joining the original on Done. A tile dropped onto a drawing still goes inside that drawing.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default. Walk: Scripts/playtest/a-component-never-holds-itself-walk.json.

try.do: Drag a Button off the Library shelf onto the page, then right-click it and choose Edit Original.
Drag another Button off the shelf over the Primary Small drawing and hold it there.
Drag a Card off the shelf over the empty page beside the grid and let go.
Drag a Badge onto any Button drawing and let go: it lands inside that drawing.
Press Done in the title bar and look at the Button on your page.

evaluate: Is "Cannot go inside itself" clear enough when you drag a Button over the Button you are editing?
Over the empty page, does "Drop it onto Button" tell you where the drop would have worked?
Should a drop on the empty page beside the drawing instead do something useful, such as go back to the page you came from?
After Done, is every copy the size and look it was before?
rough: No mock covers what a drop does inside Edit Original's space; the refusal reuses the dark note a text style drag already shows under the pointer.

Something drawn with a tool, or pasted, beside the drawing still joins the first drawing on Done, as it did before; only a pasted copy of the component itself is now left out. Only drops were in scope here.
A double click on a tile or Layer > Insert Component while the space is open lands in the middle of the view, so it is refused when the middle of the view is bare page.
